snippet.title: Doomsday Diner - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Doomsday Diner, a post-apocalyptic physics-based diner simulation game developed by Space Rock Games. Players will ensure the safe operation of a humble diner in the middle of oblivion. Serve up hot dogs, attain upgrades for the diner, and fend off evil raiders out to steal. Doomsday Diner is available now for PC (Steam).
